zh.headline: Anthropic 与三星洽谈定制 AI 芯片
zh.observation: 今天最值得关注的趋势是 "Agent 技能工程" 的爆发。GitHub 上出现了大量 Claude Code 技能集（Skills）仓库，从 Matt Pocock 的实战技能到 caveman 的极端 token 优化，再到 agentskills 的标准化尝试，表明 Agent 开发正在从 "写 Prompt" 进化到 "构建可复用的技能模块"。同时，Anthropic 与三星讨论定制芯片、微软合并 Copilot 并推出 AutoPilot、OpenAI 提议政府入股等事件，共同指向 AI 产业正在经历基础设施层和应用层的双重重构——模型能力不再是唯一瓶颈，工具生态、芯片自主、商业模式创新正在成为新的竞争焦点。最后，Simon Willison 提出的 "更好模型，更差工具" 现象和 AISI 关于基准低估 Agent 能力的研究，提醒我们随着模型能力快速提升，评估体系和工具链的适配正在成为新的关键挑战。

items.title: Anthropic 与三星洽谈定制 AI 芯片
items.desc: Anthropic 正在与三星讨论开发新的定制芯片，距 OpenAI 宣布与博通合作自研芯片仅一周。
items.value: AI 大厂加速摆脱英伟达依赖，芯片格局生变

items.title: OpenAI 提议向美国政府提供 5% 股权以缓解监管压力
items.desc: 据金融时报报道，OpenAI 向特朗普政府提议给予 5% 的国有股份，以缓和 AI 引发的公众反弹。
items.value: AI 巨头寻求政府入股，行业治理新模式探索

items.title: 微软将合并消费者和企业 Copilot，推出 AutoPilot Agent
items.desc: 微软计划在 8 月将 Copilot 应用合并为一个，同时推出后台自动处理的 "AutoPilot" 代理（需额外付费）。
items.value: AI 超级应用竞赛加速，Copilot 从工具升级为平台

items.title: Meta 悄然推出 AI 生成游戏应用 Pocket
items.desc: Meta 发布了实验性 AI 应用 Pocket，让用户通过文本提示生成和分享互动小游戏。
items.value: Meta 入局 "vibe coding" 游戏赛道，AI 创作门槛进一步降低

items.title: Anthropic 推出 Claude Science，启动自有药物研发项目
items.desc: Anthropic 发布面向科学家的 "AI 工作台" Claude Science，并宣布自研针对被大药企忽视的疾病的药物。
items.value: AI 公司从工具提供者向垂直行业执行者转型

items.title: OpenAI 联合创始人 Brockman 预言 "几乎无界面" 的未来
items.desc: Greg Brockman 认为未来没有人再学习软件使用，AI 将变成隐形的、上下文感知的智能体。
items.value: AI 交互范式从图形界面走向意图驱动，软件行业面临根本性重塑

items.title: Z.ai 推出 ZCode，挑战 Cursor、Claude Code 和 GitHub Copilot
items.desc: 北京 AI 实验室 Z.ai（原智谱 AI）发布桌面应用 ZCode，基于其旗舰模型 GLM-5.2 打造 "Agentic 开发环境"。
items.value: 中国 AI 厂商入局编码助手赛道，开源权重模型 GLM-5.2 成为差异化优势

items.title: OpenAI 推出 GeneBench-Pro：基因组学与生物学 AI 基准测试
items.desc: OpenAI 发布新基准 GeneBench-Pro，使用复杂真实世界数据集测试 AI 在基因组学、生物学和科学研究中的表现。
items.value: AI 在生命科学领域的评估标准首次系统化，推动科学 AI 能力可度量

items.title: 英国 AI 安全研究所发现标准基准系统性低估 Agent 能力
items.desc: AISI 研究表明，标准 AI 评估通过限制 token 预算系统性低估了 Agent 能力，将预算增加 10 倍后，软件工程任务成功率提升约 25%。
items.value: 现有 Agent 基准评价体系存在根本性缺陷，需重新设计评估方法

items.title: AI 漏洞报告数量激增，6 月创历史纪录
items.desc: Epoch AI 报告显示，2026 年 6 月有 21 家组织报告了约 1,500 个高危和严重 CVE，是此前月纪录的 3.5 倍以上，与 AI 驱动的漏洞挖掘工具的普及时间吻合。
items.value: AI 安全攻防进入新阶段，漏洞发现能力大幅提升带来新的治理挑战

items.title: Google DeepMind 与 A24 宣布首次研究合作
items.desc: Google DeepMind 与独立电影制片公司 A24 达成合作，探索 AI 在电影制作中的应用。
items.value: 顶级 AI 实验室与创意产业的跨界合作，AI 视频生成进入好莱坞视野

items.title: 苹果首次将私有云计算平台扩展至谷歌云
items.desc: 苹果正在将其私有云计算基础设施部署到谷歌云平台上。
items.value: 苹果 AI 基础设施战略多元化，打破对单一云厂商的依赖

items.title: GRPO、Dr. GRPO 和 DAPO 本质上是同一个操作：群标准差恒等式
items.desc: 研究发现三种主流推理训练方法（GRPO/DAPO/Dr.GRPO）都在调整同一个量——采样的标准差，揭示了这些方法的数学统一性。
items.value: 统一了推理训练的理论基础，有助于设计更高效的训练算法

items.title: 更多采样反而有害：测试时扩展的模态上限与相关上限
items.desc: 研究揭示测试时扩展（多次采样）存在天花板，覆盖率的提升不等于选择的正确率，更多采样可能反而降低最终回答质量。
items.value: 对当前 "更多采样 = 更好" 的普遍假设提出挑战，影响推理系统的设计

items.title: AutoMem：将记忆作为可学习认知技能
items.desc: 提出将文件系统操作提升为与任务操作同级的记忆行为，让模型自主管理记忆，实现元记忆能力的自动化学习。
items.value: Agent 记忆管理从手工设计走向自主学习，是 Agent 长期记忆的重要突破

items.title: PACE：Agent 能力评估的代理指标
items.desc: 研究表明，昂贵且耗时的 Agent 基准测试（如 SWE-Bench）的表现可以通过少量精心选择的非 Agent 能力测试（推理、代码生成）准确预测。
items.value: 大幅降低 Agent 评估成本，使快速迭代成为可能

items.title: Mistral 开源 Leanstral 1.5：在形式化数学基准上表现出色，并发现代码中的真实 Bug
items.desc: Mistral AI 发布用于 Lean 4 形式化验证的开源模型，在扫描 57 个开源仓库时发现 5 个此前未知的 Bug。
items.value: 形式化验证模型从学术走向实用，可自动发现真实软件缺陷

items.title: Google 发布 TabFM：零样本表格基础模型
items.desc: Google Research 发布 TabFM，支持对混合数值/分类列的结构化数据进行零样本分类和回归，无需微调或超参数搜索。
items.value: 表格数据领域迎来基础模型，零样本表格 AI 成为可能

items.title: strix ⭐1,910/天
items.desc: 开源 AI 渗透测试工具，自动发现和修复应用漏洞。
items.value: AI 安全测试民主化，开发者可免费获得专业级漏洞扫描

items.title: caveman ⭐1,089/天
items.desc: Claude Code 技能，通过 "原始人说话" 风格减少 65% 的 token 消耗。
items.value: 极端 token 优化思路，展示成本控制的另类路径

items.title: alibaba/page-agent ⭐726/天
items.desc: 阿里巴巴开源 JavaScript 页面内 GUI Agent，用自然语言控制网页界面。
items.value: 阿里巴巴的网页自动化 Agent，可用于浏览器自动化、UI 测试等场景

items.title: openai/codex-plugin-cc ⭐716/天
items.desc: OpenAI 官方发布的 Codex 插件，允许从 Claude Code 中调用 Codex 进行代码审查或任务委托。
items.value: 两大 AI 编码工具互通，跨模型协作成为现实

items.title: ogulcancelik/herdr ⭐706/天
items.desc: 终端中的 Agent 多路复用器。
items.value: 多 Agent 编排基础设施，终端工作流管理新工具

items.title: asgeirtj/system_prompts_leaks ⭐432/天
items.desc: 定期更新的系统提示词泄露集合，涵盖 Claude、OpenAI、Google、xAI 等多家公司的模型提示词。
items.value: 系统提示词逆向工程资源，对研究模型行为和 Prompt Engineering 极有价值

items.title: agentskills/agentskills ⭐351/天
items.desc: Agent Skills 的规范与文档标准。
items.value: Agent 技能标准化运动兴起，推动 Agent 生态互操作性

items.desc: Chrome 官方发布的 DevTools MCP 服务，为编码 Agent 提供浏览器调试能力。
items.value: 浏览器厂商官方支持 Agent 调试，前端开发 Agent 能力大幅增强

items.desc: LangChain 发布的 CLI 工具，自动为代码库编写和维护 Agent 文档。

items.value: 代码库知识图谱化，大幅提升 Agent 对大型代码库的理解效率

items.title: pxpipe：将文本隐藏在 PNG 中，降低 Claude Code 和 Fable 5 的 Token 成本高达 70%
items.desc: 开源工具 pxpipe 将长文本提示转换为紧凑 PNG 图片，利用 Anthropic 按像素而非文本内容计费的定价策略，节省 59-70% 成本。
items.value: 展示了 AI 定价套利的可能性，但也引发了对准确性和速度的权衡思考

items.title: "更好的模型，更差的工具"——Simon Willison 关注 Claude 模型生成无效工具调用的问题
items.desc: Simon Willison 报道了一个奇怪的问题：新版 Claude 模型（包括 Opus 4.8）在调用 Pi 的编辑工具时，会在 `edits[]` 数组中添加额外的、不存在的字段。工具调用本身通常是正确的，但参数不符合 schema，导致 Pi 拒绝执行。这引发了对 "模型能力越强，工具使用越不稳定" 的讨论。

items.title: Mark Zuckerberg 内部承认 AI Agent 进展未达预期
items.desc: 在 Meta 内部会议上，Zuckerberg 告诉员工 AI 开发进展没有他希望的那么快。这一来自全球最大 AI 投入者之一的坦诚表态，引发了关于 AI Agent 实际落地速度的广泛讨论。

en.headline: Anthropic in talks with Samsung for custom AI chip
en.observation: The most notable trend today is the explosion of "Agent Skill Engineering." GitHub is flooded with Claude Code skill repositories—from Matt Pocock's production skills to caveman's extreme token optimization to agentskills' standardization efforts—indicating agent development is evolving from "writing prompts" to "building reusable skill modules." Meanwhile, Anthropic discussing custom chips with Samsung, Microsoft merging Copilot and launching AutoPilot, and OpenAI proposing government equity all point to the AI industry undergoing dual restructuring at the infrastructure and application layers—model capability is no longer the sole bottleneck; tool ecosystems, chip independence, and business model innovation are becoming new competitive frontiers. Finally, Simon Willison's "better models, worse tools" observation and AISI's finding that benchmarks underestimate agent capabilities remind us that as model capabilities rapidly improve, evaluation systems and toolchain adaptation are becoming critical new challenges.

items.title: Anthropic in talks with Samsung for custom AI chip
items.desc: Anthropic is discussing developing a new custom chip with Samsung, just a week after OpenAI announced its own custom AI chip partnership with Broadcom.
items.value: AI giants accelerate breaking NVIDIA dependency, chip landscape shifting

items.title: OpenAI floats giving US government 5% stake to ease regulatory pressure
items.desc: OpenAI proposed giving the Trump administration a 5% ownership stake as a way to ease tensions and blunt public backlash against AI, per Financial Times.
items.value: AI giant seeks government equity, exploring new governance model

items.title: Microsoft to merge consumer and enterprise Copilot, launch AutoPilot agents
items.desc: Microsoft plans to consolidate Copilot apps into one in August, while introducing "AutoPilot" agents that handle tasks in the background for an extra fee.
items.value: AI super app race accelerates, Copilot evolving from tool to platform

items.title: Meta quietly launches vibe-coded gaming app Pocket
items.desc: Meta released experimental AI app Pocket that lets users generate and share interactive mini games using text prompts.
items.value: Meta enters "vibe coding" gaming, further lowering AI creation barriers

items.title: Anthropic launches Claude Science, starts in-house drug development
items.desc: Anthropic released "AI workbench" Claude Science for scientists and announced its own drug development programs targeting neglected diseases.
items.value: AI companies shift from tool providers to vertical industry executors

items.title: OpenAI co-founder Brockman envisions "almost no interface" future
items.desc: Greg Brockman believes nobody will learn to use software anymore; AI will become invisible, context-aware agents.
items.value: AI interaction paradigm shifting from GUI to intent-driven, fundamental software industry reshaping

items.title: Z.ai launches ZCode, challenging Cursor, Claude Code, and GitHub Copilot
items.desc: Beijing-based AI lab Z.ai (formerly Zhipu AI) released desktop app ZCode, an "Agentic Development Environment" built on its flagship GLM-5.2 model.
items.value: Chinese AI firm enters coding assistant race, open-weight GLM-5.2 as differentiator

items.title: OpenAI introduces GeneBench-Pro: AI benchmark for genomics and biology
items.desc: OpenAI released GeneBench-Pro, a new benchmark testing AI performance in genomics, biology, and scientific research using complex real-world datasets.
items.value: First systematic evaluation standard for AI in life sciences, enabling measurable scientific AI progress

items.title: UK AI Security Institute finds standard benchmarks systematically underestimate agent capabilities
items.desc: AISI study shows standard AI evaluations systematically underestimate agent capabilities by capping token budgets; increasing budget 10x boosts software engineering task success rates by ~25%.
items.value: Fundamental flaws in existing agent benchmark evaluation systems, requiring redesign

items.title: Security vulnerability reports explode, June sets historic record
items.desc: Epoch AI reports ~1,500 high-severity and critical CVEs from 21 organizations in June 2026, 3.5x the previous monthly record, coinciding with AI-powered bug-hunting tool adoption.
items.value: AI security enters new phase, dramatically improved vulnerability discovery brings new governance challenges

items.title: Google DeepMind and A24 announce first-of-its-kind research partnership
items.desc: Google DeepMind partners with independent film studio A24 to explore AI applications in filmmaking.
items.value: Top AI lab crosses into creative industry, AI video generation enters Hollywood's radar

items.title: Apple extends private cloud computing platform to Google Cloud for the first time
items.desc: Apple is deploying its private cloud computing infrastructure onto Google Cloud Platform.
items.value: Apple diversifies AI infrastructure strategy, breaking single cloud vendor dependency

items.title: GRPO, Dr. GRPO, and DAPO are three operations on one number: the group-standard-deviation identity
items.desc: Research finds three mainstream reasoning training methods (GRPO/DAPO/Dr.GRPO) all adjust the same quantity—sampling standard deviation—revealing their mathematical unity.
items.value: Unifies theoretical foundation of reasoning training, enabling more efficient algorithms

items.title: When more sampling hurts: the modal ceiling and correlation ceiling of test-time scaling
items.desc: Research reveals test-time scaling (multiple sampling) has ceilings; coverage improvement ≠ selection accuracy, more sampling can degrade final answer quality.
items.value: Challenges prevailing "more sampling = better" assumption, impacts reasoning system design

items.title: AutoMem: learning memory as a cognitive skill
items.desc: Proposes elevating file-system operations to first-class memory actions alongside task actions, letting models autonomously manage memory for automated metamemory learning.
items.value: Agent memory management evolves from hand-crafted to self-learning, key breakthrough for long-term memory

items.title: PACE: a proxy for agentic capability evaluation
items.desc: Research shows expensive agent benchmarks (e.g., SWE-Bench) performance can be accurately predicted by a small set of carefully selected non-agentic capability tests (reasoning, code generation).
items.value: Dramatically reduces agent evaluation costs, enabling rapid iteration

items.title: Mistral open-sources Leanstral 1.5: excels at formal math benchmarks, catches real bugs in code
items.desc: Mistral AI releases open-source model for Lean 4 formal verification; finds 5 previously unknown bugs while scanning 57 open-source repositories.
items.value: Formal verification models move from academic to practical, automatically discovering real software defects

items.title: Google releases TabFM: zero-shot tabular foundation model
items.desc: Google Research releases TabFM supporting zero-shot classification and regression on structured data with mixed numerical/categorical columns, requiring no fine-tuning or hyperparameter search.
items.value: Foundation models arrive for tabular data domain, zero-shot tabular AI becomes viable

items.value: Democratizes AI security testing, free professional-grade vulnerability scanning for developers

items.value: Top developer's production skills open-sourced, best practice reference for agent skill engineering

items.value: Alibaba's web automation agent for browser automation, UI testing, and more

items.desc: OpenAI's official Codex plugin that allows calling Codex from Claude Code for code review or task delegation.

items.title: "Better Models, Worse Tools" — Simon Willison highlights Claude models generating invalid tool calls
items.desc: Simon Willison reports a strange problem: newer Claude models (including Opus 4.8) add extra, non-existent fields in the `edits[]` array when calling Pi's edit tool. Tool calls are usually correct but arguments don't match schema, causing Pi to reject them. This sparks discussion on whether "stronger models lead to more unstable tool use."

items.title: Mark Zuckerberg internally admits AI agent progress slower than hoped
items.desc: At a Meta internal meeting, Zuckerberg told staff AI development wasn't moving as quickly as anticipated. This candid admission from one of the world's largest AI investors sparked widespread discussion about the actual pace of AI agent deployment.
